environment.description: Same IoT gateway code deployed on identical hardware but managed through AWS IoT Greengrass v2 with container isolation. The Greengrass component recipe specifies a Linux process-level namespace configuration with a custom OCI runtime spec. The runtime spec includes a syscall filter definition (compatible with libseccomp 2.5.x notation) that operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode for the following syscall groups: process_execution (covers __NR_execve, __NR_execveat, __NR_fexecve), process_tracing (__NR_ptrace, __NR_process_vm_readv, __NR_process_vm_writev), and raw_network (__NR_socket, __NR_socketpair, __NR_connect, __NR_bind). The filter is applied via prctl(PR_SET_SECCOMP) before the Python interpreter loads the application module, meaning the interpreter itself is already loaded but cannot spawn child processes or open new network connections. The MQTT message ingestion occurs through Greengrass IPC (unix domain socket inherited before seccomp activation), so message receipt still functions. Additionally, the component runs under a dedicated posix user (ggc_user:ggc_group) with no sudo capabilities and the container filesystem is mounted read-only except for /tmp (noexec,nosuid).

config.mqtt_ingestion: greengrass IPC over inherited unix socket
